result.summary: Selected the official TACC Stampede3 User Guide page (docs.tacc.utexas.edu/hpc/stampede3/). This single page is the primary TACC documentation covering system architecture (compute node types including ICX, SPR, SKX, GPUs), network section, file systems and scratch purge policy, production queues and Slurm submission (sbatch) including common options, job scripts and job management, and account/file management. It therefore covers submission, resources, storage, and networking at a user-facing level.
unanswered_topics: Per-user or per-project disk quotas for home, work, and scratch (numeric limits not clearly shown in the available excerpt).
Precise network topology and measured interconnect performance numbers (bandwidth/latency per node or per link).

Detailed per-partition/queue resource limits such as default CPUs, memory, GPUs per node for each partition (tables may exist but numeric defaults or constraints for specific partitions were not confirmed).
Any site-specific limits on concurrent jobs, job submission rate limits, or scheduler QOS settings beyond the general job accounting description.
Procedures and contact details for requesting access to specific compute nodes or exceptions (the page warns not to request specific nodes but exact approval workflow is not detailed).
Policies or tools for large-scale data transfers (e.g., recommended Globus endpoints, ftp, or data-mover services) beyond general file system navigation.
